title: incident-bot: link SLO toolkit telemetry to oncall runbooks & diagnostics
author: Maya Singh
description:
Motivation: On recent incidents we observed that on-call responders spend time context-switching between the incident chat and SLO/telemetry dashboards to validate burn rates, latency regressions, and correlated alerts. This PR integrates the SLO Toolkit telemetry surface into incident-bot's runbook suggestions and on-call diagnostics payload so responders get one-click links and a short summary (burn rate, recent breaches, top affected routes) in the same context as runbook recommendations.

What this changes: - Adds a telemetry linker that queries the SLO Toolkit API for recent SLO events and generates compact telemetry cards (burn-rate summary, last breach timestamp, top affected services). - Enriches runbook links emitted by incident-bot with telemetry_card links and a short text summary to help triage faster. - Adds server-side feature toggle (config: oncall.telemetry_linking.enabled) and rollout flag per-team. - Adds unit and integration tests that simulate SLO Toolkit responses and verify graceful degradation when telemetry is unavailable. - Adds metrics: incident_bot.telemetry_link_requests, incident_bot.telemetry_link_failures, and telemetry_link_latency_ms.

Implementation notes: - New package internal/oncall/telemetry_linker.go implements a small client with caching (TTL 30s) to avoid extra load during noisy incidents. - Requests to SLO Toolkit are rate-limited using the shared request token bucket (aligns with existing SLO client patterns). - Telemetry cards are rendered as compact markdown + deep link to the SLO Toolkit dashboard with preselected filters for the incident's service and time window. - Default behavior is OFF. Risk mitigations: feature toggle, per-team opt-in, circuit-breaker on SLO Toolkit errors, and conservative cache.

Testing & rollout: - Unit tests added for linker logic and markdown rendering. - Integration test added to incident-bot e2e suite that uses a recorded SLO Toolkit fixture. - Rollout plan: enable for SRE sandbox, monitor telemetry_link_failures & latency, then enable for core infra teams, then ramp to org-wide.

Related: ENG-1432 (reduce time-to-triage), SRE-089 (oncall playbook improvement).

release_notes:
- incident-bot: experimental feature to include SLO Toolkit telemetry links and compact summaries in runbook suggestions (off by default; opt-in per team).
- Added metrics: incident_bot.telemetry_link_requests, incident_bot.telemetry_link_failures, telemetry_link_latency_ms.
notes: This is a production-facing instrumentation feature behind a toggle. Ops: watch incident_bot.telemetry_link_failures during rollout. If SLO Toolkit credentials misconfigured, incident-bot will fallback to runbook-only suggestions.
